{"query":"WITH pairs AS (
  SELECT
    bollywood_song,
    film,
    film_year,
    source_song,

    source_year,
    hindi_composer,

  UNION ALL

  SELECT
    bollywood_song,
    film,
    year AS film_year,
    earlier_song AS source_song,
    original_artist AS source_artist,
    original_year AS source_year,
    composer AS hindi_composer,
    claim AS relationship,
    url,
    title
  FROM r0b1d6aa89f2
  WHERE bollywood_song IS NOT NULL
    AND earlier_song IS NOT NULL
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    *,
    REGEXP_EXTRACT(url, 'https?://(?:www\\.)?([^/]+)', 1) AS domain,
    CASE
      WHEN url LIKE '%filmcompanion.in/%' THEN 1
      WHEN url LIKE '%scroll.in/%' THEN 1
      WHEN url LIKE '%indianexpress.com/%' THEN 1
      WHEN url LIKE '%hindustantimes.com/%' THEN 1
      WHEN url LIKE '%firstpost.com/%' THEN 1
      WHEN url LIKE '%huffpost.com/%' THEN 1
      WHEN url LIKE '%news18.com/%' THEN 2
      WHEN url LIKE '%itwofs.com/%' THEN 3
      ELSE 5
    END AS source_priority
  FROM pairs
)
SELECT
  SEM_NORM(bollywood_song) AS bollywood_song,
  ANY_VALUE(film) AS film,
  TRY_CAST(MODE(film_year) AS INTEGER) AS film_year,
  SEM_NORM(source_song) AS earlier_song,
  ANY_VALUE(source_artist) AS earlier_artist,
  TRY_CAST(MODE(source_year) AS INTEGER) AS earlier_year,
  ANY_VALUE(hindi_composer) AS hindi_composer,
  ANY_VALUE(relationship) AS reported_relationship,
  COUNT(DISTINCT domain) AS independent_domains,
  COUNT(DISTINCT url) AS source_pages,
  MIN_BY(url, source_priority) AS source_url,
  MIN_BY(title, source_priority) AS source_title
FROM ranked
WHERE LENGTH(bollywood_song) BETWEEN 2 AND 100
  AND LENGTH(source_song) BETWEEN 2 AND 120
GROUP BY
  SEM_NORM(bollywood_song),
  SEM_NORM(source_song)
HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT domain) >= 3
ORDER BY
  independent_domains DESC,
  source_pages DESC,
  bollywood_song
LIMIT 100","show_preview":false}
